answer: Divergent-Commitment Audit. Each identity must periodically post an umber-signed commitment to a future random challenge before seeing it. Enforcement: a clone farm cannot precompute divergent replies without running separate independent state, so shared instances collide. Audit sampling then exposes correlated answers, and violators forfeit a relic deposit plus lose their prism credential. Attacker cost: one full isolated execution stack and forfeited deposit per surviving identity.
